title: Sales Pipeline
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Open pipeline
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(c.amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.crm_opportunities c WHERE c.stage NOT IN ('won', 'lost') AND c.expected_close_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND c.expected_close_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'

kpis.label: Weighted pipeline
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(c.amount * c.probability_pct / 100.0), 2) FROM dash_demo.crm_opportunities c WHERE c.stage NOT IN ('won', 'lost') AND c.expected_close_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND c.expected_close_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'

kpis.label: Open deals in the window
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.crm_opportunities c WHERE c.stage NOT IN ('won', 'lost') AND c.expected_close_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND c.expected_close_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'

kpis.label: Quota attainment this quarter
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT sum(c.amount) FROM dash_demo.crm_opportunities c WHERE c.stage = 'won' AND c.closed_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND c.closed_date <= DATE '2026-09-30') / (SELECT sum(q.quota) FROM dash_demo.rep_quotas q WHERE q.quarter_start = DATE '2026-07-01'), 2)

kpis.label: Next quarter's pipeline against its quota
kpis.sql: SELECT round((SELECT sum(c.amount) FROM dash_demo.crm_opportunities c WHERE c.stage NOT IN ('won', 'lost') AND c.expected_close_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND c.expected_close_date < DATE '2027-01-01') / (SELECT sum(quota) FROM dash_demo.rep_quotas WHERE quarter_start = DATE '2026-10-01'), 2)

density.rule: a rate that carries a finding needs 50 in its denominator per bucket
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.crm_opportunities c WHERE c.stage IN ('won', 'lost') GROUP BY c.lead_source)
